{{Quote|Sergeant Harbon told me something about a time like this on Ferton.|The mercenary|<ref name="RPG" />}}
An '''individual''' worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At one point, the mercenary worked with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Harbon]], who told them about a situation they had been in on [[Ferton]].<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mercenary was first mentioned in "The Merc" character template, which was included in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RPG" />
